reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 argument-1 of FUNCTION FACTORIAL must be an integer argument (§1989:A.2.2 AR4: integer item, literal, integer function or always-integral expression, never a numeric function, §1989:A.2.3 GR2), refused at compile time when it is not, and its value must be >= 0, a permissible-value constraint whose breach leaves the result undefined (§1989:A.2.2 p3); a legal argument yields 1 for zero and n! otherwise.

reader.notes: The Verified row Uniform('i') routes argument-1 through IntegerViolation, which refused every non-integer shape probed at --std 85 with §1989 citations; >= 0 is checked in CobolIntrinsics.Factorial and a breach terminates the run unit at 85, which §1989:A.2.2 p3 (undefined) permits. Legal values, including an ODO element, a P-scaled integer item and nested integer functions, return the exact factorial.
reader.at-2023: the same compile-time refusals; a negative value raises EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION

refuter.evidence: Legal argument-1 forms beyond the reader's: integer functions by argument type, FACTORIAL(FUNCTION MAX(A B)) = 24, MIN = 6, SUM(A 1) = 24, ORD-MAX(A B 1) = 2, INTEGER-PART(S) + 5 = 6, A ** 2 - 5 = 24 (intfn.cob); FUNCTION MAX(TE(ALL)) and SUM(TE(ALL)) over an ODO table = 24 and 5040, MAX(A * (A + 1) / 2 1) = 720, COMP, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE items, ZEROS = 1, INTEGER(BN / 2) = 2 (legal2.cob). Refusal half: a group (r_grp.cob), a numeric-edited item (r_edit.cob), reference modification (r_refm.cob) refused COBOL1627 as non-numeric; an index-name refused COBOL1637 (r_idx.cob); TE(ALL) refused COBOL1645 citing §1989:A.2.2 (r_allf.cob); MAX(A 2.5), SUM(A 0.5), RANGE(A 0.5) refused as numeric functions (r_maxmix, r_sumx, r_rngx); (FUNCTION SQRT(4)) in parentheses refused (p_paren.cob). FUNCTION SQRT(4) + 1 is accepted and gives 6 (r_sqrtp.cob), FUNCTION SQRT(2) + 1 terminates at run time naming 2.414... (c_sqrt2.cob): the undecided-expression determination, whose breach is undefined at 85 (§1985:I.1.6). Class c: FUNCTION ABS, BYTE-LENGTH refused COBOL1502 at 85. The 2.0 literal reading as in the ANNUITY case. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.14.3 AR1 'Argument-1 must be an integer greater than or equal to zero'; OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4; OK §1989:A.2.3 GR2; OK §1985:I.1.6; FAIL then corrected: the ALL-subscript paragraph is §1989:A.2.2 p4, not p5.
